ruleDefinitions.name: UAC Bypass Using MSConfig Token Modification - Process
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the pattern of UAC Bypass using a msconfig GUI hack (UACMe 55)

sequences.query: ((process_integrity_level = "High" OR process_integrity_level = "System" OR process_integrity_level = "S\-1\-16\-16384" OR process_integrity_level = "S\-1\-16\-12288") AND parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Temp\\\\pkgmgr\\\.exe$") AND process_command_line = "\"C\:\\Windows\\system32\\msconfig\.exe\"\ \-5")
